levels.surface: أبو القاسم جعفر بن محمد بن قولويه القمي الفقيه
سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف

notes: the first link is named in the text as its own shaykh; the text writes him as a transmitter, so he is an ordinary narrator (rule 13); this reading does not decide whether he is the compiler
the Imam speaks «سمعت أبا عبد الله (ع) يقول» — the last item (owner ruling 2); the addressee «يا فلان» and the questioner Ibn Abi Ya'fur are scene people, not links
